data.summary: The change covers all acceptance criteria: Home/About boxes with a black active state, a ThemeToggle next to PrivacyToggle on desktop and mobile, light/dark/system persistence, an inline pre-paint script in Layout, dark variants across components, and tested pure helpers in theme.js. QA reports 52 tests passing. Only minor and nit-level improvements remain.

findings.issue: The preference is synchronised through several overlapping paths: the preferenceRef effect, the manual ref assignments in the handlers, and the setPreference call in select(). The THEME_CHANGE_EVENT listener already updates state, so select()'s own setPreference is redundant and the ref is written in multiple places.
findings.suggestion: Keep a single update path: derive the ref in the one effect on [preference], and let select() call only setTheme (the event listener updates state). That removes the duplicate ref assignments.

findings.issue: The pre-paint logic in Layout.astro duplicates getStoredTheme, resolveTheme and applyTheme. The two copies can drift apart, and the inline copy is untested.
findings.suggestion: Add a short comment in both places stating that they must be kept in sync, since an is:inline script cannot import the module.

findings.issue: Formatting: `}from` is missing a space. In theme.js, `setTheme =(` is also missing a space.
The mobile menu container still uses the gray-50/gray-800 palette while the rest of the dark theme uses slate.

architectureNotes: Theme logic is correctly isolated in a pure, dependency-injected lib/theme.js (storage, document and matchMedia are injected), so it is unit-testable under node:test.
The chart modal tracks the html dark class via a MutationObserver, which also covers system-driven changes without extra wiring.
positives: Injectable storage, document and matchMedia make the tests deterministic.
Tests cover the invalid-value fallback, a storage that throws, system changes, and unsubscribe.
Inline script prevents a flash of the wrong theme.
Header refactor removed the duplicated link class strings.
Cross-tab sync via the storage event and a same-page event.
